decisions.reason: As a niche extension of the firm’s established spraying business in a growing industry, it is likely to be retained despite some uncertainty signaled by its lighter website presence.
Because it is very close to the firm’s core offer and was given its own page, management would likely view it as meeting aspirations well enough to continue.
This product fits the existing pump and material-handling portfolio, and the firm’s engineering slack makes continued market testing more likely than withdrawal.

Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm’s move toward more digitalized customer solutions, so an innovative medium-sized machinery firm would likely keep it unless clear underperformance emerges.
